articles.summary: Chart has signed a strategic North American distribution partnership with Ratermann Manufacturing under which Ratermann will serve as the exclusive distributor for Chart’s complete line of industrial MicroBulk and portable liquid cylinder tanks.
articles.title: Chart and Ratermann announce distribution partnership

articles.summary: Real Ale Brewing Company has installed and implemented CiCi carbon capture technology at its brewery in Blanco, becoming one of the first large-scale craft breweries in Texas to incorporate small-scale CO2 recovery into its operations.
articles.title: Award Winning Texas Brewery Installs CiCi® Carbon Capture Technology
